Independent final-SHA code/evidence assessment of Crystal Ball PR #1757

Exact immutable final SHA: 4e409ae78101fd9fb28ba22c42b72cbfd3a73961, based on main 1ff91232e2e759e03c338986ef3f3ccdececeb79. Verified final parent dbf4382d39756898d781b6a6208fa9cd2decc8eb. The final commit changes only docs/plans/2026-09-29-r4-bug-002-notification-delivery.md and docs/validation/R4-BUG-002-NOTIFICATION-DELIVERY.md; the actual code/test review at dbf remains applicable. Reused my complete original review at ea6588a68 and saved repair-one incremental review at dbf, without repeating unchanged implementation review or executing tests.

Final conclusion: APPROVED at exact SHA 4e409ae78101fd9fb28ba22c42b72cbfd3a73961 over main 1ff91232e2e759e03c338986ef3f3ccdececeb79. ZERO blocking findings and ZERO other actionable findings. The original P2 same-alert retry finding is resolved in repair cycle ONE. The mandatory evidence gap identified in the preceding assessment is now resolved by a QA-only extension, with no production changes or additional repair cycle.

Both retry layers are repaired. A native attempted non-delivery makes the router retain an in-memory pending alert and resolve false. The actual subscription forwards that promise. The reactor releases only the matching emission's dedupe entry, so the next ingest reaches the pending path before the persistent inbox duplicate check. Retry repeats only native, honors current policy, clears on delivered and preserves successful dedupe. The persistent-inbox end-to-end tests cover rate_limited, failed, unavailable, throws, delivered dedupe and one-time inbox/toast/map; Ghost Mode and stale-report/rejection fixtures are substantive. Memory-only retries and initial policy-skip settlement remain explicitly documented limits. Main critical policy/config files, lockfile, npmrc, review recorder, validation gate and Cargo inputs checked are preserved, and range-diff confirms only mechanical original rebase changes plus bounded repair.

Evidence independently checked
Both raw manifests are anchored at dbf with the matching immutable tree. All 15 TS mutations O1–O4/O6/N1–N10 and Cargo O5 have actual nonempty applied diffs whose original source/context matches the immutable files, nonzero red counts with relevant assertions, matching immutable before/after SHA-256 and clean-before/after restoration metadata/logs. Actual raw counts match the manifests. TS baselines are 77 pass / 0 fail both before and after; Cargo baselines are 7 / 0 both. Cargo O5 reports two assertion panics with 5 / 2, not an infrastructure failure. No September historical summary is substituted for raw proof. Integrated red-before-fix is 33 tests / 25 pass / 8 fail and green-after-fix is 33 / 33 / 0, distinct from the earlier prep runs.

The final agentic log explicitly names 4e409ae, starts with clean status, runs all six requested scripts and ends "Agentic validation gate passed.", gate-exit=0 and clean status. Raw suite results: native-notify 5/0 plus 72/0; notifications 227/0; iMessage 6/0 plus 63/0; iMessage-native 1/0; desktop-updater 13/0 plus 22/0; native-responsiveness 13/0. Full Cargo raw results are 83/0, 9/0, 44/0, 7/0 and 9/0, with focused notify contract 7/0. The first gate's dependency-layout build failure is retained and superseded by a successful final gate, not presented as a passing run.

Mandatory evidence gap resolved by the exact-SHA QA-only extension
Independently inspected all 17 additional applied diffs, raw red assertions/counts and restore logs against immutable 4e409ae source, plus the full before/after baselines and clean restoration metadata. Both manifests name exact 4e409ae and its tree f8070e03c407e458ebc6e116d46bda8f4384423a. Every mutated source hash matches the immutable source and restored full SHA-256. Raw counts match the manifests; Cargo failures are actual assertion panics with no ignored/filtered tests, not build failures. No tests were rerun by this reviewer.

Five Cargo proofs: C1 independent critical lane (2 pass / 5 fail), C2 token consumption (5/2), C3 refill (5/2), C4 refill cap (6/1), C5 unknown/missing-priority Normal fallback (6/1). Each targets the real policy guard and reds its new fixture; before/after baselines remain 7/0.

Twelve TS/source-gate proofs: P1 summary coalescing threshold (75/2); P2 highest member priority, P3 member names, P4 undelivered-summary marking, V1 speak_aloud honest rate-limit call site, L1 evacuation mapping, L2 hazmat mapping, L3 spill mapping, L4 air-quality mapping, NS1 non-safety news producer mapping, H1 priority forwarding and H2 default priority (each 76/1). Source-only gates mutate the actual text they inspect; behavioral tests mutate the helper body they execute. Before/after baselines remain 77/0. These tests are the new original feature families identified in the preceding assessment, rather than newly imposed unchanged behavior requirements.

Together with the 16 previously independently verified proofs, there are 33 actual red/restored proofs. The evidence extension satisfies the previously identified AGENTS.md/feature-workflow mutation prerequisites without changing the frozen production implementation. Artifacts: mutation-evidence-extension/{cargo,ts}/manifest.json and referenced diffs/test/restore logs; reviewer verification summary sol-extension-evidence-verification.json. The preceding blocked assessment is preserved as sol-evidence-blocked-4e409ae78101fd9fb28ba22c42b72cbfd3a73961.txt. The committed validation document describes the original 16 regenerated proofs; the task-folder extension supplies the additional 17 and is explicitly included in this final conclusion. The gate already ran successfully at this same unchanged final SHA; no repeat gate is required for external proof artifacts alone.

QA provenance/limits
Recorded fresh npm ci --ignore-scripts dependencies use the final/main lockfile (its independently checked SHA-256 matches the QA inputs) and unchanged npmrc, on Node 22.23.1/npm 10.9.8. The outer QA install package differs from dbf only in the test:native-notify script, not dependency sections or lockfile; the final gate installs inside the QA worktree. Older implementation-worktree dependencies were used only for exploratory red/green/hooks, not substituted for final validation. Cargo uses generated gitignored sidecar and synthetic dist/index.html with a shared build cache; these are contract tests, not desktop installation proof. Native delivered means successful handoff, not demonstrated OS banner visibility. No installed-app/OS-banner smoke, native notification, real osascript, Keychain, provider calls or real user data were used. Installed-app smoke is expressly recommended, not a mandatory premerge prerequisite in the approved immutable plan. This change introduces no external provider/data source requiring a live probe.

Model controls: supported GPT-6.1 Sol, medium reasoning, same single independent reviewer, no delegation; configuration evidence is not provider-signed runtime identity. Read-only immutable Git/source and recorded QA artifacts, except saving requested review evidence. No runtime tests, production edits, network, credentials, user/native operations, Claude communication, verdict recording or publication. This actual concluding output approves only the exact reviewed SHA; no verdict was recorded and no publication or merge was performed.
